accepted.title: Regressive Martin dichotomy on arithmetic degrees
accepted.text: In ZF+AD, let f:2^ω→2^ω respect arithmetic equivalence and satisfy f(x)≤_A x for every x. Here y≤_A x means y is Turing reducible to some finite iterate of the Turing jump of x. Must there be an arithmetic cone on which either f(x)≡_A a for one fixed real a, or f(x)≡_A x? An arithmetic cone is {x:b≤_A x} for some b.
accepted.subject: Logic & Foundations
accepted.citation: Question 9.5, printed p. 131 / held PDF p. 139; definitions and conventions in Chapters 1, 4–6.

accepted.title: Order-preserving Martin dichotomy on hyperarithmetic degrees
accepted.text: Under ZF+AD, if f:2^ω→2^ω satisfies x≤_H y⇒f(x)≤_H f(y), must some hyperarithmetic cone satisfy either f(x)≡_H a for one real a, or x≤_H f(x)? Here ≤_H is hyperarithmetic reducibility and a hyperarithmetic cone is {x:b≤_H x} for some b.

accepted.title: ZF strength of the Borel measure-preserving Martin theorem
accepted.text: Does ZF prove that every Borel Turing-invariant f:2^ω→2^ω satisfying (∀a)(∃b)(∀x≥_T b) f(x)≥_T a also satisfies (∃c)(∀x≥_T c) f(x)≥_T x? Turing invariance means x≡_T y⇒f(x)≡_T f(y).

accepted.title: A nonprincipal ultrafilter strictly below Martin measure
accepted.text: Work in ZF+AD. Let D be the Turing degrees and U_M their cone ultrafilter. For ultrafilters U,V on D, U≤_RK V means U=F_*(V) for some F:D→D, where A∈F_*(V) iff F⁻¹(A)∈V. Equivalence means reducibility both ways; it does not require a bijection. Does some nonprincipal ultrafilter U on D satisfy U≤_RK U_M but U_M≰_RK U?
accepted.subject: Logic & Foundations

accepted.title: Lebesgue and Baire ultrafilters below Martin measure
accepted.text: Work in ZF+AD. Let D be the Turing degrees and U_M their cone ultrafilter. For ultrafilters U,V on D, U≤_RK V means U=F_*(V) for some F:D→D, where A∈F_*(V) iff F⁻¹(A)∈V. Equivalence means reducibility both ways; it does not require a bijection. Let U_L consist of subsets A⊂D whose inverse image under x↦deg_T(x) has fair-coin measure one, and let U_B consist of those whose inverse image is comeager. Do U_L≤_RK U_M and U_B≤_RK U_M hold?

excluded.title: Rudin–Keisler maximality of Martin measure on Turing degrees
excluded.text: Work in ZF+AD. Let D be the Turing degrees and U_M their cone ultrafilter. For ultrafilters U,V on D, U≤_RK V means U=F_*(V) for some F:D→D, where A∈F_*(V) iff F⁻¹(A)∈V.
